title: Data Through Pictures
introduction: ‘Data Through Pictures’ is developed as a mathematical investigation rather than a list of rules. The chapter connects data collection, pictographs, keys and scales, comparison, interpretation. Learners are expected to represent quantities or relationships, choose a strategy, calculate carefully, check the result and explain the reasoning.
